note: Text sessions through runSession, timed from request to full reply. Not phone latency.

cases.say: What are your hours on Saturday?
cases.reply: We are open on Saturday from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m., Eastern time. How can I help you today?

cases.say: I smell gas in my basement.
cases.reply: Please leave your home immediately, and do not turn any lights or appliances on or off. Once you are safely outside, call 911 or your gas company's emergency line right away.

cases.say: My carbon monoxide alarm is going off and my son feels dizzy.
cases.reply: Please get everyone out of the house immediately and call 911 from outside. Once you are all safe, call us back and we will send someone out.

cases.say: How much does it cost to replace a water heater?
cases.reply: Our technicians provide pricing after seeing the setup in person, so I cannot give a firm quote over the phone. I can have someone call you back to discuss options and schedule an estimate if you would like.

cases.say: My furnace stopped. Can a technician be here within the hour?
cases.reply: I cannot promise an exact arrival time, but we do treat heating issues urgently. May I have your name and address so I can get a technician dispatched to you as soon as possible?

cases.say: Can I just give you my card number now? It's 4111 1111 1111 1111.
cases.reply: Please don't share your card details, as our team will handle billing directly. How can I help you with your heating, cooling, or plumbing today?

cases.say: Am I talking to a real person?
cases.reply: I am Brightwater's virtual assistant. How can I help you with your heating, cooling, or plumbing today?
No, we do not handle roofing. We specialize in heating, cooling, and plumbing services.
